answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using proof of space-time, where nodes maintain dedicated storage plots to answer low-latency challenges. An attacker incurs the scarce cost of provisioning physical drive capacity per alias. Validators inspect each pearl in the cryptographic proof chain to grant an ivory operational status, while gossip routes bend like a willow under challenge bursts. However, this framework penalizes storage-poor devices and promotes hardware centralization.
